artifact_reason: Replica notes state issues(filter:...) ignores the parent filter. In step 3-4 the solver filtered by parent:{id:{eq:"i-epic"}} and assignee:{id:{eq:"u-sam"}}, and the replica returned i-6 even though i-6's real parentId is "i-5" (sub-issue of "Checkout analytics"), not the Checkout revamp epic. The solver never fetched parentId directly, so it reasonably trusted the server-side filter that a real Linear API would have honored, and the real service would not have returned i-6 for that query.
note: Step 4's parent-filtered query wrongly returned decoy i-6 due to the replica's documented ignored-parent-filter behavior; the solver then updated i-6's state to Done in steps 7-9 based on that response, never itself reading the (unreturned) parentId field.
